title: Picked Clean
description: This remakes the textures of Minecraft to be more towards PVP.
body:
This is a resource pack that is for general use, but is PVP oriented. This is my first resource pack, so some things might be off or different from similar resource packs. Textures are subject to change.

Release 1.1: changed texture for copper armor and totem of undying

Full release 1.0: Made textuers for orange, lime, light gray, light blue, gray, cyan, pink, and white wool. Also changed the crosshair to be more PvP friendly.

Beta Version 0.2: Made textures for purple, green, magenta, and brown wool.

Beta Version 0.1: This is the first version before full release. Changed textures for black wool, blue wool, blue concrete, red concrete, and all swords.
